get_history_processor_by_name: use HistoryProcessor.get to retrieve a registered history processor instance by its class name
truncate_history_to_last_n: use LastNObservations to keep the first and last N user messages and summarize older ones
replace_outdated_code_windows: use ClosedWindowHistoryProcessor to replace outdated code windows for the same file with line count summaries
pass_through_history_unchanged: use DefaultHistoryProcessor to return conversation history without any modifications
summarize_old_user_messages: use last_n_history to keep the first message and last N user messages while summarizing older output
